verdict.rationale: Aider is a coding assistant, so live-app debugging is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents only adjacent features: `/run` runs a command and shares its output, `/web` scrapes a page into markdown, and screenshots can be added as context. None of these attaches to, inspects, or debugs a live running web application, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
